words.label: WHAT CAN YOU SEE?
words.body:
Highlights include the newly restored *Poetry Ireland and Irish Heritage Trust building on Parnell Square*, private homes and landmarks including the *GPO, Kilmainham Gaol and EPIC*.

The wider programme also includes talks, workshops and exhibitions across the city.

*Open House Junior* takes place on *10 & 11 October*, with family-friendly architecture workshops and tours.

*All events are free*, although advance booking is required for many.
